files.name: SurfaceSwim.java

help: After shore fails in water: swim by hand on the surface toward seen land, switching targets on stalls
lesson: Shore TIMEOUTs repeat because the pathed swim keeps going to the same unreachable land. Swimming by hand with a stall check every 5 s, which drops the stalled target or turns, should keep the bot moving instead of spending another 90 s in place.
summary: surface_swim takes over when shore has timed out or got stuck in water. It swims by hand on the surface (forward, sprint, jump) toward seen land, and on a 5 s stall it drops that target or turns 90°.
